questions.question: Explain file permissions versus directory permissions when granting a service access to one configuration file.
questions.sampleAnswer: Unix mode bits grant read, write and execute rights separately to the owner, group and everyone else. For example: A teammate belongs to the file group but cannot open a file under a private parent directory. Inspect permissions on every parent directory.
